long_biography.plain_text:
In Atlanta, Stolz raised campaign funds and worked for mayor Andrew Young before moving into community-bank business development. Industrial distribution then gave him a larger operating canvas. He became an acquisition-led executive, expanding across North America, integrating more than two dozen businesses and building import relationships in China and India.

After retiring from Würth, Stolz established Sunbury Capital as a private investment platform spanning industrial private equity, property and mezzanine lending. His public-service work has included chairing North Carolina's Economic Development Board and Chamber of Commerce, as well as major health and cultural boards. The state awarded him the Order of the Long Leaf Pine for that civic contribution.
